description: Line-range masks selecting the C++ implementation sections modeled by lean/consensus. Mapped files default to fully included; listed ranges exclude mechanisms explicitly outside lean/consensus (periodic task registration, uncommitted-transaction and ledger-backlog backpressure, batch-size byte heuristics, periodic signature disposition, recovery-only force_become_primary/remove_deleted_nodes/enable_all_domains, external RPC/snapshot view-history queries, diagnostic status queries, commit_observer callbacks, trace-capture helpers, the KV Store/Adaptor bridge, and std::formatter logging boilerplate). Aft::periodic (CheckQuorum and election dispatch), recv_message error arms, and ConfigurationChangeHook remain included.

exclude.reason: JobBoard periodic task registration is unmodeled (lean/consensus models no wall clock)
Ledger-backlog and uncommitted-transaction backpressure are unmodeled
Periodic signature scheduling (should_sign / SignatureDisposition) is unmodeled
Trace-capture-only helper emitting ccf.cft retired_committed_tx events is unmodeled
Disaster-recovery node deletion without retirement and node-identity reuse are out of scope of lean/consensus
Recovery-only public/private security-domain deserialisation toggle is unmodeled
Disaster-recovery four-argument force_become_primary overload is unmodeled (bootstrap zero-argument overload remains included)
External RPC/snapshot view-history query accessors are unused by consensus transitions
Read-only diagnostic/telemetry status snapshot is unmodeled
Ledger I/O backlog message dropping is unmodeled (message loss is modeled non-deterministically by the network queue)
Byte-size moving-window AppendEntries batching heuristic is unmodeled
Helper used only by unmodeled get_signature_disposition
External CommitObserver callback notification is unmodeled
External RPC/snapshot view-history slice queries (get_history_until, get_history_since) are unused by consensus transitions
KV Store interface and weak-pointer Adaptor bridge are abstracted away by NodeState.log in lean/consensus
